sentences.text: The heterogeneous presentation separates the cells by dimension; here, heterogeneous refers to the dimensions, not to the sorts.
Its categorial extension has a sort for every pair made of a dimension up to N and a sort of Sigma:
Each operation symbol gets one copy in every dimension, acting on the cells of that dimension.
Sources and targets go down to every lower dimension, identities go up, and every composition has its domain condition.
For instance, in dimension one, the copy of sigma takes an arrow of sort s and an arrow of sort t, and returns an arrow of sort s, whose source is computed by the copy of sigma in dimension zero.
Again, the heterogeneous N categorial algebras are the E P algebras that satisfy a set of Q E equations.
So we have two categories of algebras for the same signature.
